$description: TeachingBubble (platform/components/TeachingBubble, library wave 5, lane A; the brand bubble and its spotlight, lane B): its component tokens. The widths and arrow geometry are Popover's (md, lg when wide); the surface is the brand blue with the color on the brand for its text, icons and actions (owner, 2026-10-13); the buttons are Button's, recolored on the blue.

teaching-bubble-media-margin-block-end.$description: TeachingBubble: the space under the picture.

teaching-bubble-header-gap.$description: TeachingBubble: the gap between the title and Close.

teaching-bubble-header-min-height.$description: TeachingBubble: the header is at least as tall as Close (the inline-action role).

teaching-bubble-title-text.$description: TeachingBubble: the title, in the color on the brand.

teaching-bubble-title-font-size.$description: TeachingBubble: the title's size (Popover's title size).

teaching-bubble-title-line-height.$description: TeachingBubble: the title line is as tall as Close (the inline-action role), so its first line centers on the button without an offset.

teaching-bubble-text-margin-block-start.$description: TeachingBubble: the space between the header and the text.

teaching-bubble-footer-gap.$description: TeachingBubble: the gaps in the footer (between the actions, and before the step count).

teaching-bubble-footer-margin-block-star.$description: TeachingBubble: the space above the footer.

teaching-bubble-step-text.$description: TeachingBubble: the step count, in the color on the brand (no muted step on the blue: it keeps the text contrast).

teaching-bubble-background.$description: TeachingBubble: the surface and the arrow, the brand blue (owner, 2026-10-13).

teaching-bubble-border-color.$description: TeachingBubble: the edge and the arrow's outline, the brand blue (one piece with the surface).

button-on-inverse-text.$description: TeachingBubble: the text, Close and the secondary action, in the color on the brand.

button-on-inverse-focus-color.$description: TeachingBubble: the focus ring of its buttons and its own focused edge, in the color on the brand (the focus color is the blue itself).

button-on-inverse-action-fill.$description: TeachingBubble: the primary action's fill (and a secondary action under the pointer), the color on the brand.

button-on-inverse-action-text.$description: TeachingBubble: the label on that fill, the brand blue.

button-on-inverse-action-outline.$description: TeachingBubble: the outline of the secondary action (and of the primary and Close under the pointer).

button-on-inverse-action-quiet-backgroun.$description: TeachingBubble: no fill: the secondary action and Close at rest, the primary under the pointer (the blue shows through).

teaching-bubble-text.$description: TeachingBubble: the text, Close and the secondary action, in the color on the brand.

teaching-bubble-focus-color.$description: TeachingBubble: the focus ring of its buttons and its own focused edge, in the color on the brand (the focus color is the blue itself).
